in_marathi.name: Chidambar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky-clad, wearing the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chidambar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is referred to as Chidambar. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘chid’ meaning sky and ‘ambar’ meaning to wear. It signifies the deity being dressed in the sky.
